svg.title: Plate PL-01 — The Markov blanket: MIND / BODY / MIND.BODY / WORLD
svg.desc: An engraved reference plate of the four-way Markov-blanket partition. Internal states mu (MIND), sensory states s, active states a, and external states eta (WORLD); the blanket b equals the set of s and a, which is BODY. The defining conditional independence is p(mu, eta given b) equals p(mu given b) times p(eta given b), equivalently mu is conditionally independent of eta given b, equivalently the conditional mutual information I(mu; eta given b) equals zero nats. Two routes are drawn: the world reaches the mind only through sensory states, and the mind reaches the world only through active states; the direct route is crossed out. A nesting figure shows blankets within blankets, fenced NOT-MEASURED. A quantified figure shows the human visual funnel with retinal and optic-nerve counts. A marginal note carries the Pearl-blanket versus Friston-blanket caveat. The plate anchors to kitchen rule M12 and claims no UNI rung.
svg.text: μ (internal) · s (sensory) · a (active) · η (external) · b = {s, a} — the four-way partition and its one conditional independence
FIG. 1 — THE PARTITION AND ITS TWO ROUTES

text.tspan: A PEARL BLANKET is a formal statistical construct —
variables in a graph you drew, relative to a model,
doing conditional-independence bookkeeping. Cheap,
well-defined, unobjectionable. Pearl (1988).
A FRISTON BLANKET is a metaphysical boundary of a
thing — a claim that some real system out there
genuinely has an inside, a surface, and an outside.
The field's main error is sliding from the first to
the second without paying for it: you define a
blanket (free — a modelling choice), then quietly
conclude you have discovered where the organism
ends (expensive — an empirical claim requiring
I(μ;η|b) ≈ 0 in the actual system, which nobody
estimated). Bruineberg, Dołęga, Dewhurst &
Baltieri (2022), The Emperor's New Markov Blankets,
Behav Brain Sci 45:e183, DOI
10.1017/S0140525X21002351. The dispute is live.
And the formal conditions are worse than assumed.
Aguilera, Millidge, Tschantz & Buckley (2022), Phys
Life Rev (arXiv:2105.11203) analytically solved a
family of linear Langevin / Ornstein–Uhlenbeck
systems and found the three requirements — a
perception–action partition, a Markov blanket, and
decoupled solenoidal flows — are in principle
independent conditions, co-occurring only in a
“very narrow space of parameters”. The systems this
framework most wants to describe — living things:
asymmetric, non-equilibrium, solenoidal — sit
largely outside it. [NA04-03 · MODELED]
THEREFORE, PLAINLY: a Markov blanket is a
MODELLING CHOICE you must justify per system, not
a fact you may assume. Any use of the partition in
this corpus — including M12 — is a typed
engineering choice, warranted by being useful and
explicit, never by having been discovered in
nature.
This plate takes no side beyond insisting the slide
be named.

svg.text: FIG. 2 — THE DEFINING CONDITION: ONE CONDITIONAL INDEPENDENCE
p(μ, η | b) = p(μ | b) · p(η | b)⇔μ ⊥ η | b⇔I(μ ; η | b) = 0
Given the blanket, internal and external states carry no further information about each other. Every dependency between mind and world is routed through the body.

Not mostly. Not usually. By definition — or the partition is not a blanket. I is conditional mutual information, in NATS; the required value is 0 nats [NA04-02]. The partition is MODELED and definitional [NA04-01]; the term is Pearl's (1988).
FIG. 3 — NESTING: BLANKETS WITHIN BLANKETS (THE GRADIENT)

text.tspan: Nothing in the definition fixes a scale. A blanket's internal states can themselves be a set of blanketed
things, and the construction recurses — each level's blanket becomes part of the next level's internal states:
organelle → cell → tissue → organ → organism → colony → ecosystem
Palacios, Razi, Parr, Kirchhoff & Friston (2020), J Theor Biol 486:110089, DOI 10.1016/j.jtbi.2019.110089;
Kirchhoff, Parr, Palacios, Friston & Kiverstein (2018), J R Soc Interface 15(138):20170792.
A CONSTRUCTION, NOT AN OBSERVATION. That blankets can compose this way is a mathematical fact.
That any particular biological hierarchy IS so composed is a separate empirical claim.
n_levels — NOT-MEASURED [NA04-13]. Units: nested blankets. Scope: any named organism, established
by measurement rather than by choosing a diagram. Source: none found. Falsifier: estimate I(μ;η|b) at
each candidate level of one real organism and count the levels that pass.
INTEROCEPTION — a blanket inside the blanket. Cardiac, gastric, respiratory, inflammatory and osmotic
channels are sensory states whose external states are other parts of the same organism: from the brain's
position, the viscera are η. f_aff (human cervical vagus) = sensory 73.9 ± 7.5 % (R) / 72.4 ± 5.6 % (L) of
fibres, with 13 ± 5.9 % / 14.3 ± 4.0 % sympathetic riding along. Scope: 8 cadavers, immunofluorescence.
OBSERVED-CONTESTED [NA04-10] — Kronsteiner et al. (2024), Brain Stimulation 17(3):510–524,
DOI 10.1016/j.brs.2024.04.016. Falsifier: independent replication in a larger cohort; a sensory fraction
outside ~65–82 % refutes. The circulated “~80 % afferent” is a RAT ABDOMINAL measurement
[NA04-09] — a number quoted outside its scope is a defect even when the number is right.

svg.text: FIG. 4 — THE BLANKET, QUANTIFIED: THE HUMAN VISUAL FUNNEL

text.tspan: Not a window: a lossy, unevenly weighted, individually variable compression
stage — and it is the entire visual world's only door.
Scope — N_rod, N_cone, D_cone,fovea: human retina; 8 wholemounts, 7 donors, ages 27–44. Curcio, Sloan,
Kalina & Hendrickson (1990), J Comp Neurol 292:497–523, DOI 10.1002/cne.902920402. N_optic: human
optic nerve; 22 nerves, 19 subjects, ages 20–75. Jonas, Müller-Bergh, Schlötzer-Schrehardt & Naumann
(1990), Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 31(4):736–744. Falsifier for all four: recount in a comparable cohort;
a mean outside the stated range refutes.
r_retina IS MODELED, NOT MEASURED [NA04-08]. The assumptions are the fence: (N_rod + N_cone)/N_optic,
computed across DIFFERENT COHORTS, UNPAIRED, with no per-eye matching, and ignoring non-uniform
convergence (foveal ≈ 1 : 1 vs peripheral ≫ 100 : 1). Falsifier: measure both counts in the same eyes;
a paired ratio outside ~50–150 : 1 refutes this estimate.

svg.text: THE FOUR SETS AND THE BLANKET
EVIDENCE CLASSES USED HERE — NATURA, NOT THE UNI FENCE

text.tspan: μ internal states — MIND. Never touches η; only ever its own blanket.
s sensory states — the world's only route in.
a active states — the mind's only route out.
η external states — WORLD. Reached exactly never; only inferred.
b the blanket, b = {s, a} — BODY. The only route between μ and η.
μ ↔ b MIND.BODY — not a fifth set: the coupling; a pair of one-way doors.
z the system's states, partitioned into the four disjoint subsets above;
μ̇ and η̇ are their rates of change.

svg.text: sensory route ①: η → s → μ (solid, filled tip).
active route ②: μ → a → η (dashed, open tip).
An actual route here means I(μ;η|b) > 0 — the
partition is drawn in the wrong place.
stipple = η · hatch = b · wash + heavy ring = s, a · blank = μ.

text.tspan: OBSERVED-REPLICATED — measured, and independently replicated
across labs, datasets or taxa.
OBSERVED-CONTESTED — measured, but the community genuinely
disputes the value or the mechanism. Both positions carried.
MODELED — derived from a model that fits data. The model's
assumptions ARE the fence.
HYPOTHESIZED — mechanism proposed, not settled. Not claimed.
NOT-MEASURED — the honest empty face: nobody has measured it.
Printed rather than filled.
1. THE PARTITION — FIG. 1. A system's states z partition into four disjoint subsets: internal μ (MIND),
sensory s, active a, external η (WORLD). The blanket is b = {s, a} — BODY. MIND.BODY ③ is not a fifth
set: it is the coupling μ ↔ b, a pair of one-way doors. Nothing in the definition fixes a scale.
2. THE DEFINING CONDITION — FIG. 2. Given the blanket, internal and external states carry no further
information about each other; every dependency between mind and world is routed through the body.
Not mostly, not usually — by definition, or the partition is not a blanket. The term is Pearl's (1988),
coined for efficient inference over a graph already drawn. The free-energy literature adds a directional
sparsity requirement on top ④: ∂μ̇/∂η = 0 and ∂η̇/∂μ = 0, which for linear Gaussian systems reduces to
the vanishing of the internal–external blocks of the precision matrix, H_μη = H_ημ = 0, in precision
units [NA04-03, MODELED]. Friston (2013), J R Soc Interface 10(86):20130475, DOI
3. THE TWO ROUTES ① ②. A mind can never touch the world; it can only ever touch its own blanket.
Every inference is an inference from sensory states; every act is a perturbation of active states. The
generative model is not a model of η — it is a model of how η is expected to show up in b. The world
enters as a hypothesis that explains the blanket. Embodiment is therefore not decoration: the blanket
determines what is inferable at all.
4. ACTION AS INFERENCE ②. Prediction error is resolvable two ways: change μ (update the model to fit
the world) or change a (change the world until it fits the model). Both minimize the same quantity —
action is inference run through the other half of the blanket. A cold mammal can revise its prediction of
its own temperature, or it can shiver; only one is survivable, and the preference C over sensory states
breaks the tie — which is why the free-energy story needs preferences and cannot be pure inference.
That descending motor signals are proprioceptive predictions rather than commands is HYPOTHESIZED
[NA04-14] — mechanism proposed, not settled. Adams, Shipp & Friston (2013), Brain Struct Funct
5. THE OPERABLE TEST. A candidate boundary b around a candidate interior μ is a real blanket exactly
when I(μ;η|b) = 0 nats, estimated over the system's actual trajectories. I > 0 beyond estimator noise
means a route runs from world to mind bypassing the body ④, and the partition is drawn in the wrong
place. THE CRITERION IS CLEAN AND OVERWHELMINGLY UNEXERCISED: NOT-MEASURED for essentially
all real biological systems [NA04-02]. When a paper — or this corpus — says “system X has a Markov
blanket,” the default assumption should be that I(μ;η|b) was never estimated.
6. ANCHOR — M12. This plate extends kitchen rule M12, WORLD ⊥ BODY ⊥ MIND — “Two typed Markov
blankets; interoception = hardware signals” (cookbook/01-kitchen-rules.md). M12 is status: method — a
governance pattern, not a capability claim and not an observation about nature. This plate supplies the
natural-science reading of the same partition and RAISES NOTHING: M12's status is unchanged by every
citation on it. The operator's fourth term, MIND.BODY, is the one M12 leaves implicit ③.

tspan.tspan: 7. WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM.

text.tspan: (a) Not claimed: that a Markov blanket implies a self, an experiencer, awareness, sentience, consciousness,
or a point of view. EXPLICITLY DISCLAIMED — nothing in the partition names one, and no falsifier is offered
because none exists. Receipt: the same formalism admits partitions for Newton's cradle, a burning fuse and
the Lorenz attractor — Beck & Ramstead (2025), arXiv:2502.21217, ran blanket detection on exactly those.
If a blanket implied a self, it would imply one for the burning fuse. Recorded INADMISSIBLE; never mocked.
(b) Not claimed: that the free-energy principle is true, that blankets are universal, or that living systems
generally satisfy the blanket conditions — the exact analysis says those conditions are narrow (margin).
(c) Not claimed: that UNI has a Markov blanket in the Friston sense. M12 is a typed engineering partition,
status: method — warranted by explicitness, never by discovery. No I(μ;η|b) estimated for any UNI boundary.
(d) Not claimed: that the nesting ladder has a known depth [NA04-13], that r_retina is a measured quantity
[NA04-08], or that the vagal afferent fraction is settled [NA04-09, NA04-10].
(e) Not claimed: that anything on this plate raises any UNI rung. A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE.
Every source is published science; the honest position stands at ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned.
(f) Not a target: “full human” and “the next evolution beyond human” are QUAESTIO APERTA — permanent open
questions, never a milestone, never a deliverable. Nothing in the blanket formalism moves them closer.
(g) This plate is DESIGN-ONLY: it carries no script, no event handler, and no external reference.
8. SOURCE. encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/NA-04-mind-body-world.md; rows NA04-01 … NA04-14 of encyclopedia/
NATURE-LEDGER.md. Classes per NA-00 (twelve classes in three groups, amended 2026-07-15). Every number
carries value + units + scope + class + source + falsifier, or is printed NOT-MEASURED. Where this plate and
the ledger disagree, THE LEDGER WINS.
